limitations: Endpoint thread counters omit checkpoint threads that start and finish within the window.
Rounded self sample totals and inclusive caller totals have different precision; nested samples must not be summed.
CPU observations do not identify blocked-time causes.
Queue wall time includes enqueue, channel and mutex waits, and scheduling until work begins.
Work wall time can include backend reads, scheduling, and CPU. It is not task CPU.
Queue/work sums for different workers overlap; they are not writer blocked-time totals.
Diagnostic counters add cache probes; throughput is not production qualification.
Read wall time includes CPU and off-CPU intervals. Backend reads are not physical disk reads.
The measured workload supplies bindings; root and cascade opportunities are not demonstrated.
